verse.verse_1: By the (winds) sent forth in quick succession,
verse.verse_3: and raise (clouds) and scatter them around,
verse.verse_5: and then cast (Allah's) remembrance (in people's hearts),
verse.verse_6: to serve as an excuse or a warning.
verse.verse_7: Surely what you are promised shall come to pass.
verse.verse_8: So when the stars are extinguished,
verse.verse_9: and the sky is rent asunder,
verse.verse_10: and the mountains are blown away,
verse.verse_11: and the appointed time to bring the Messengers together arrives, (then shall the promised event come to pass).
verse.verse_12: To which Day has this task been deferred?
verse.verse_14: What do you know what the Day of Judgement is?
verse.verse_15: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verse.verse_16: Did We not destroy many a nation of the earlier times?
verse.verse_17: And We shall cause those of later times to follow them.
verse.verse_18: Thus do We deal with the guilty.
verse.verse_19: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verse.verse_20: Did We not create you of a mean fluid,
verse.verse_21: which We then placed in a secure repository
verse.verse_23: See that We had the power to do so. Great indeed is Our power to do what We will.
verse.verse_24: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verse.verse_25: Did We not make the earth a receptacle,
verse.verse_26: for the living and the dead,
verse.verse_27: and did We not firmly fix towering mountains on it and give you sweet water to drink?
verse.verse_28: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verse.verse_29: Proceed now towards that which you were wont to deny as false;
verse.verse_31: which neither provides (cooling) shade nor protection against the flames;
verse.verse_32: it indeed throws up sparks like castles,
verse.verse_33: which seem as though they are yellow-coloured camels.
verse.verse_34: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verse.verse_35: That will be the Day on which they will not (be able to) utter a word,
verse.verse_36: nor will they be allowed to proffer excuses.
verse.verse_37: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verse.verse_38: That is the Day of Judgement on which We have assembled you as well as all those who went before you.
verse.verse_39: So if you have any ploy, try it against Me!
verse.verse_40: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verse.verse_41: Behold, today the God-fearing will be amidst shades and springs,
verse.verse_42: and the fruits that they desire (will be ready at hand).
verse.verse_43: Eat and drink and may every joy attend you as a reward for your deeds.
verse.verse_44: Thus do We reward those that do good.
verse.verse_45: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verse.verse_46: Eat and enjoy yourselves for a while. Surely you are evil-doers.
verse.verse_47: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verse.verse_48: When it is said to them: “Bow down (before Allah),” they do not bow down.
verse.verse_49: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verse.verse_50: In what discourse after this (Qur'an) will they, then, believe?
